headline: THE DIVERGENCE IS FULLY ATTRIBUTED AND EXACTLY REPRODUCED. T002 rendered its two subjects with BOTH resident in the scene, hiding one per render with hide_render. A hidden object still participates in EEVEE lighting. Reproducing that arrangement returns T002 committed reading to six decimals; isolating the subject returns this session reading.

theDecisiveExperiment.subject: the byte-identical v1 tile

arrangements.setup: Both subjects resident, the other hidden by hide_render — T002 arrangement.
arrangements.note: T002 committed 0.042303 and ratio 1.072801. Reproduced to six decimals.

arrangements.setup: As A, and the hidden subject additionally excluded from shadow casting.
arrangements.note: Brighter still, so the hidden objects were casting shadows onto the measured subject.

arrangements.setup: The other subject collection excluded from the view layer.
The other subject deleted — the pinned arrangement.

theDecisiveExperiment.finding: Presence of a hidden subject brightens the measured subject by 7.0%. hide_render suppresses camera visibility only; it removes neither shadow casting nor whatever else EEVEE derives from scene contents. C and D agree exactly, so exclusion and deletion are equivalent and either is sufficient.
theDecisiveExperiment.consequence: T002 tone MISS at 1,200 m / azimuth 235 was an ARTIFACT OF ITS SCENE ARRANGEMENT, not a property of the tile. The pinned spec forbids hide_render and requires subject isolation.

hypothesesTested.method: Baked tile at 1200/235 under FILTER_0, FILTER_2, FILTER_8, FILTER_16.
hypothesesTested.result: NO EFFECT. Identical to eight decimal places at every setting.
hypothesesTested.verdict: REJECTED as a cause. Still pinned, because a setting proven inert today is not guaranteed inert after an engine update.

hypothesesTested.result: NO EFFECT beyond the eighth decimal.
hypothesesTested.verdict: REJECTED as a cause. Still pinned, same reasoning.

hypothesesTested.result: ENORMOUS effect — ratio 1.002152 against 2.322015 — but in the wrong direction and two orders of magnitude too large for a 6% gap.
hypothesesTested.verdict: REJECTED as a cause. Retained as a reminder that this is the single most destructive misconfiguration available.

fourThousandTwoThirtyFiveTooDark.observation: At 4,000 m / azimuth 235 the tile reads 0.942736 against the source, a 5.7% deficit, and it persists under the pinned instrument and reproduces exactly.
fourThousandTwoThirtyFiveTooDark.isItAnArtifact: NO. It survives subject isolation and full instrument pinning.
fourThousandTwoThirtyFiveTooDark.mechanismEvidence: It is the SOURCE that moves, not the tile. Between 1,200 m and 4,000 m at azimuth 235 the source mean rises 0.03943247 -> 0.04218957 (+7.0%) while the baked mean is almost flat, 0.03951735 -> 0.03977362 (+0.6%). The source brightens under minification and the prism does not.
fourThousandTwoThirtyFiveTooDark.attribution: A REAL SUBJECT DIFFERENCE, attributed to geometry the prism does not carry. The source rooftop clusters are sub-pixel at 4 km and average into brighter values; the prism has no rooftop mass to average. This is consistent with T011 ablation finding that rooftop mass is a large effect at shadow poses.
fourThousandTwoThirtyFiveTooDark.confidence: Mechanism is INFERRED from the distance trend, not demonstrated by a controlled ablation at 4 km. Stated as an inference.

hueSpreads.observation: Per-channel spread runs 0.016 to 0.034 and exceeds the 0.02 bar at five of six poses.
hueSpreads.isItAnArtifact: PARTLY MASKED BEFORE, NOT CREATED NOW. T002 recorded 0.006 to 0.016 and passed 6 of 6, under the residency arrangement that brightened the tile and pulled its channel ratios toward unity. Under isolation the spread is larger and mostly out of bar.
hueSpreads.distanceDependence: GROWS WITH DISTANCE at both azimuths: 0.016 -> 0.021 -> 0.023 at azimuth 55, and 0.026 -> 0.025 -> 0.034 at azimuth 235.
hueSpreads.channelPattern: RED IS CONSISTENTLY THE DEFICIT CHANNEL. At 4,000/235 the per-channel ratios are 0.907, 0.931, 0.941; at 1,200/235 they are 0.964, 0.985, 0.990. The tile is red-deficient relative to the source and increasingly so with distance.
hueSpreads.attribution: TILE PROPERTY, not instrument. It reproduces exactly under the pinned spec, it has a coherent channel signature, and it grows with minification. The most likely mechanism is the far tier flat-face averaging and its single-atlas composition losing red relative to the source per-material factors, but NO controlled test isolates that here.
hueSpreads.confidence: Attribution to the tile is well supported. The MECHANISM is UNATTRIBUTED and is left so rather than guessed.

unexplainedResidue.statement: None material. The 6% divergence that motivated this task is fully explained and reproduced on demand. What remains unattributed is the MECHANISM behind the tile red deficit, not any variance in the instrument.
unexplainedResidue.instrumentVarianceUnderPinning: 0.0 at every pose across two cycles separated by a deliberate full perturbation.

notClaimedHere: No fix is proposed or applied to the tile; this task is attribution only.
The mechanism by which a hidden object brightens a render was not traced into EEVEE internals; the effect was measured, bounded and eliminated by the spec.
